meta.title: MySSH — SSH client with an MCP server and AI assistant
meta.description: A fast, native, open-source SSH client for macOS, Windows and Linux. SFTP, jump hosts, an MCP server for Claude Code and Claude Desktop, and an AI assistant that asks before it acts.
nav.label: Main
hero.title: The SSH client that lets AI help, only where you allow it.
hero.lead: A fast native terminal, SFTP and jump hosts, plus an MCP server and a built-in AI assistant. Every host has its own policy, risky commands wait for your approval, and every call is logged.
hero.fine: Apple silicon · macOS 13 or later · signed, notarized and self-updating
facts.label: At a glance
facts.mcpSub: Claude Code, Claude Desktop and more
facts.openSub: Free, no account, data stays local
features.title: Everything you reach for every day
features.lead: Built for people who live in terminals: quick to open, quiet to use, and careful with your credentials.
f.hosts.d: Hosts, reusable password or key identities, proxies and tags, with instant search. Import from the previous MySSH version.
f.terminal.d: True colour, IME input, search and clickable links. It follows your working directory, so SFTP opens right where you are.
f.sftp.d: Browse, upload, download and edit remote files. Drag and drop, a transfer queue, and safe handling of symbolic links.
f.jump.d: Multi-hop ProxyJump chains with an identity per hop, plus HTTP and SOCKS5 proxies. Reconnect with one click.
f.rdp.d: RDP hosts open in your system client, optionally tunnelled through an SSH jump host. Passwords never land in .rdp files.
f.backup.d: Password-protected export and import of your hosts and identities. English, 简体中文 and 日本語 built in.
ai.title: Ask why it broke. Approve what it runs.
ai.lead: Open the assistant with Ctrl+Shift+A, attach the host and the terminal output, and ask. It reads logs and runs commands through the same tools and policies as the MCP server, and shows each step as a card you can approve or deny. Secrets are masked before anything is sent.
ai.p.offD: The default. The host is invisible to AI.
ai.p.readD: Read files and terminals; only allow-listed commands run.
ai.p.askD: Every command and file change waits for your approval.
ai.p.trustedD: Routine work runs; high-risk commands, overwrites and deletes still ask.
ai.p.fullD: Everything runs; high-risk actions are flagged in the audit log.
ai.note: Works with Claude, OpenAI, DeepSeek, or a local OpenAI-compatible server such as Ollama. Your API key is stored encrypted on your computer.
mcp.title: Give Claude Code your servers, not your passwords.
mcp.lead: MySSH runs a local MCP server so Claude Code, Claude Desktop and other MCP clients can work on your hosts. Credentials never leave MySSH; clients only see the hosts you share.
mcp.s1: Turn on the server. It listens on 127.0.0.1 and a local socket only, protected by a token.
mcp.s2: Choose a policy for each host you want to share.
mcp.s3: Copy the one-line setup for Claude Code, or the JSON snippet for Claude Desktop.

sec.title: Careful by default
sec.lead: MySSH keeps your credentials on your computer and makes every AI action visible.
sec.storage.d: SQLite with AES-256-GCM field encryption for passwords, keys and conversations.
sec.key.d: The master key lives in the system keychain, or behind an Argon2id master password.
sec.local.d: The MCP server listens on 127.0.0.1 and a local socket, with a bearer token. No account, no cloud.
sec.redact.d: Tokens, keys and passwords in terminal output are masked before they reach an AI model.
sec.audit.d: Every MCP and AI tool call is recorded: who, which host, what, and whether you approved it.
sec.hostkey.d: Known hosts with trust-on-first-use, and a clear warning when a host key changes.
dl.title: Get MySSH
dl.mac.d: Unzip and move MySSH.app to Applications. It is signed and notarized by Apple, and updates itself from Settings → Updates.
dl.mac.fine: Coming from the Tauri version (v0.0.4 or earlier)? MySSH offers to import your hosts on first start.
dl.source: Build from source with the .NET 10 SDK for now.
footer.text: Open source under the GNU AGPL v3.0 or later.
hero.fineWin: Windows 10 or later · x64 · self-updating · not code-signed yet
dl.win.d: Run the installer; MySSH installs for your user and updates itself. The build isn't code-signed yet, so SmartScreen may ask: More info → Run anyway.
